messages:
raj: FYI escalating a customer billing complaint from ACME EMEA. They say the invoice we sent shows an unexpected FX surcharge and VAT lines they don't recognize. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/34567
emma: putting the basic details here — invoice ID `INV-2026-0421-ACME-EMEA`, currency EUR but customer requested local SGD invoices per their AP team. They also attached a PO that needs to appear on the invoice.
raj: right, customer says the net amount vs what they expected differs by ~€12.34 — they suspect FX rounding or a system fee.
olivia: I pulled the invoice metadata. Billing system shows: original_amount: EUR 10,234.56, converted_amount: SGD 15,678.90, fx_rate: 1.5312, rounding_policy: banker_rounding, tax_breakdown: VAT 20% applied to gross.
matt: banker_rounding can create 1-2 unit diffs on totals when line items are split. If they requested SGD invoice we should have generated a local-currency invoice with their entity code and local VAT handling. Did they submit `po_number` on the account?
raj: they attached a PO but it didn't make it to the invoice. Support logs show `po_number` was present in the ticket metadata but not in the invoice payload to the billing api. Example payload we fed: `{ "customer_id": "acme-emea", "currency": "EUR", "items": [...] }` — no `po_number` field.
olivia: hmm that explains the PO omission. The FX/rounding issue is separate — the conversion path used our nightly FX snapshot (rate recorded at 00:00 UTC) which differs from their bank rate. No surcharge configured in code, just conversion + rounding.
emma: customer explicitly asking for: 1) reissue in SGD with PO on invoice, 2) breakdown of FX calculation, 3) credit for the discrepancy if > €10. They flagged collection hold if not resolved.
matt: proposal: reissue a corrected invoice in SGD using their entity (local VAT rules), apply `rounding_policy: invoice_level_round_half_up` to match AP team expectations, and issue a credit note for the €12.34 diff if finance approves. Will need manual step in accounting system because our auto-generator doesn't support per-account rounding override yet.
raj: can we reproduce? Steps I took: 1) call billing api POST /invoices with payload copied from support logs, 2) run FX conversion using archived snapshot, 3) compare totals. Repro is consistent — the 12.34 delta appears with banker_rounding. I attached the curl and output in the ticket.
ollivia: (typo) — olivia: I mean I added a quick script to simulate per-line vs invoice-level rounding. Results attached in thread: `rounding_sim.csv`.
billing-bot: SYSTEM: Invoice `INV-2026-0421-ACME-EMEA` created by autoflow at 2026-04-21T07:12:03Z. Currency=EUR, ConvertedTo=SGD, FXSnapshot=2026-04-21-00:00, Rounding=banker_rounding.
emma: tagging @finance for approval on the credit (amount €12.34). Also need approval to reissue in SGD and to include PO.
matt: @emma FYI reissue steps (manual): 1) void existing invoice in accounting UI 2) create manual invoice with currency=SGD and `po_number` populated 3) append line item for FX adjustment if credit issued 4) post and send to customer. I can do the manual create if finance ok's credit.
raj: customer wants ETA. What's realistic? Manual reissue + credit approval = 1 business day if finance responds today.
olivia: I'm happy to prepare the SG invoice draft and the FX calculation pdf to send to them. I'll include the conversion math: base EUR -> FX rate 1.5312 -> pre-round SGD per-line -> invoice-level rounding.
emma: decision: Approve reissue, approve credit up to €15 (to cover small volatility). Finance please confirm by EOD. @matt please hold on manual create until finance confirms.
matt: copy that. I'll stand by. :thumbsup:
raj: I replied to the customer: "Thanks — we will reissue in SGD with your PO and review the small delta. Will update within 24h."
billing-bot: NOTE: Creating manual invoice will create a reconciliation task in accounting queue #A-4972.
olivia: attached: `acme_fx_calc.pdf` and draft invoice `INV-2026-0421-ACME-EMEA-SGD-draft.pdf`.
emma: Finance, any objections? This is a clear operational bug: `po_number` must be passed from ticket metadata into invoice payload. We should also add a quick unit test to ensure `po_number` parity.
matt: support/engineering follow-up item — I can add an alert to detect missing PO on generated invoices for accounts with `requires_po=true`.
raj: customer reply: "Thank you — please confirm when reissued. Our AP needs the PO on the invoice to release payment."
olivia: finance slacked back: approved credit €12.34 and approved reissue in SGD. They asked to include an explanation line on the credit note: "FX rounding correction".
emma: marking resolved once reissue is sent. @matt please update support ticket with invoice link.
matt: manual invoice created and sent at 2026-04-21T15:24:10Z: `INV-2026-0421-ACME-EMEA-SGD-1`. Credit note `CN-2026-0042` issued for €12.34. I updated ticket and attached PDFs.
raj: customer confirmed receipt and said AP accepted and payment scheduled. Closing the hold. :tada:
emma: follow-ups: engineering to add `po_number` passthrough unit test, billing to add a flag to prefer invoice-level rounding for local-currency reissues, ops to document manual reissue steps in runbook.
raj: thanks everyone. Closing thread.
